archetypes.name: prune-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Precision pruning depends on ledger schema and attribution compatibility.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the prune ledger schema transition and attribution paths. Check that code-review and plan-review records write compatible seven-column rows, old ledgers fail open, and plan labels match classification tokens. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: round-gates
archetypes.rationale: Round gating must not accidentally prune protected rounds or failure states.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on reviewer_prune_filter, review_core zero-finding exits, and plan_review_round execute_round. Verify rounds 1-2 and 5 stay unpruned, the off override wins, and plan-review failure or main-agent-vote states do not record misleading launched history. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
